role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 擅长从远处操控战斗，天涯墨客洞察所有动向，评定所有路线，决定何时从如墨的黑暗中现身控制对手，挥毫将他们一同束缚。他喜爱释放幻影的奴隶侵扰对手，而自己就慎重考虑，怎样给众多敌人写下最后一笔。
hero_summary_en: Skilled at manipulating battle from the outskirts, Grimstroke studies every movement and assesses each line, deciding when to emerge from inky darkness to disable his victims and bind them together with a swipe of his brush. He delights in unleashing phantom thralls to vex opponents, as he carefully considers how to dispatch multiple enemies with one fateful stroke.

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits. Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
facet_text_en: Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.
facet_text_zh: 绝笔额外从另一只手发出对称的墨迹曲线。每个敌人只能受到一道墨迹的伤害，但是同时计入两道墨迹的额外伤害。

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
abilities.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
abilities.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

abilities.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.

shard_loc.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。驱散类型：弱驱散

facet_text_en: Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 墨涌可以手动提前引爆。

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
abilities.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
abilities.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

abilities.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
abilities.description_zh: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
abilities.description_en: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes_zh: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。
notes_en: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续%debuff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。
notes_en: Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.
